description.value: Your exoskeleton bears small shoots that can share life. When using your @UUID[Compendium.avant.ancestryfeatures.Item.Sunlight Healing], you can restore the Hit Points of an adjacent ally instead of yourself. That ally becomes temporarily immune to all uses of Sunlight Healing for 1 day.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse
